scope: Synthetic browser fixtures and real DSH Web projections of synthetic Session/PTC records. No model or tool execution. The final archive contains the same client bytes. Desktop installation and old-setting preservation have a separate private receipt.
limitations: Only the current already-loaded UI Chat source is borrowed; unmatched or special native summaries fall back conservatively.
Code view is a visual representation, not executable Python.
No sustained model-session, Windows/Linux or desktop FPS claim.
